Rude and Unmotivated Crowd: No discipline, no gym etiquette. People sit on machines scrolling their phones instead of working out.
Unresponsive Management: Once they take your money, they vanish. No support, no help, and they ignore all complaints.
In short: unhygienic, unsafe, and unprofessional.
⚠️ Do yourself a favor and stay far away from this place. Plenty of better gyms out there that actually care about their members.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Honest Review

Congratulations, Thanekars! It seems we've got a new lounge/dance bar after the closure of the Secret and MH04—and it's located right opposite the closed location hence maybe they want to give that feel (see attached video).

People come to a gym to train their bodies, not to work out amidst deafening music and flashy nightclub-style lights. I understand that the facility remains open until 1 AM, but trust me, working out after 11 PM becomes a nightmare. The attached video clearly shows how much the surrounding environment is being misused.

About the Gym

Space: Very spacious with a large workout area.

Equipment: Well-maintained and adequately equipped for most fitness needs.

Trainers: Unfortunately, most trainers seem more focused on personal training (PT) sessions. I've often seen young members performing exercises incorrectly while trainers are either occupied with PT clients, sitting with their phones, or selectively assisting a few members (women to be honest). Proper floor supervision appears to be lacking.

Final Verdict

With Gold's Gym located barely 100 meters away, I would strongly recommend exploring that option if your goal is serious fitness training and a peaceful workout environment.

This facility has great potential, but the management's handling of the atmosphere and member experience is disappointing. No matter how many complaints are raised, things improve briefly and then quickly return to square one.

If you still join then be ready to get deaf or geting glasses with big numbers
